data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1 (orchestration leg): differ-emitted (inbound, probe) mutations are routed to inbound_probe.probe() and translated into observable follow-on mutations end-to-end.

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_probe_dispatch.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] hard_delete branch emits ('inbound', 'delete', key) follow-on against the local jira-<key> ticket
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_probe_dispatch.py::test_hard_delete_emits_inbound_delete
- [ ] project_move branch emits ('inbound', 'reparent', key, new_project_key) follow-on
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_probe_dispatch.py::test_project_move_emits_reparent
- [ ] trash_restore branch emits NO follow-on mutation but writes one audit-log entry with branch='trash_restore' and key
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_probe_dispatch.py::test_trash_restore_no_op_with_audit
- [ ] out_of_window branch emits NO follow-on mutation but writes one audit-log entry with branch='out_of_window' and key
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_probe_dispatch.py::test_out_of_window_no_op_with_audit
- [ ] inbound_probe.probe is invoked exactly once per (inbound, probe) mutation key
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_probe_dispatch.py::test_probe_called_once_per_key

## Implementation Notes

Branch → follow-on mapping (PINNED — sub-agent must NOT deviate):

| ProbeResult.branch | Follow-on emitted | Audit log |
|---|---|---|
| hard_delete | ('inbound', 'delete', key) — delete local jira-<key> ticket | branch + key |
| project_move | ('inbound', 'reparent', key, new_project_key) — update local with new project | branch + key + new_project |
| trash_restore | NONE (no follow-on mutation) | branch + key (operator visibility — Jira may auto-restore) |
| out_of_window | NONE (no follow-on mutation) | branch + key (operator visibility — issue still exists but outside fetcher window) |

Modify plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/reconcile.py:
- Import probe + ProbeResult from inbound_probe.
- When processing differ output, for each mutation tagged ('inbound', 'probe', key), call probe(key) and translate the returned ProbeResult.branch per the table above.
- Audit-log destination: emit via the existing alert_store.append({'event': 'inbound_probe_branch', 'branch': ..., 'key': ...}, repo_root) pattern (alert_store API is append(record, repo_root)).
- 'reparent' action tag may not yet exist in cde1-30ba's vocabulary — if grep confirms it's missing, add it as part of T3 (one-line vocabulary registration) with a comment linking back to this task.

Tests mock inbound_probe.probe to return each of the 4 ProbeResult shapes and assert the orchestrator emits the documented follow-on (or no follow-on) and writes the documented audit entry.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED: reconcile.py routes (inbound, probe) mutations + emits 4 branch-specific follow-ons
